job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain end-to-end web applications
Build responsive, user-friendly frontend interfaces
Develop, integrate, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs
Write clean, secure, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices
Work with databases, design schemas, and optimize queries for performance
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues
Collaborate with designers, product managers, and developers to meet project requirements
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and team meetings
Ensure application performance, security, and scalability
Basic networking, docker and Kubernetes.



Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Experience with frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
Proficiency in at least one backend technology: Node.js, Java, Python, or PHP
Hands-on experience with RESTful API development
Working knowledge of databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB
Experience using Git and version control systems



Soft Skills

Good communication skills in English (written and verbal)
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities
Ability to work independently as well as in a team
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies



Good to Have

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies
Exposure to testing and debugging tools
